findings.text: The plain-words statement says "the run succeeds once", but it never says that the formula also sets `ready := true` (the model describes the statement on the database) or that the run has no alternative executions, so one conjunct of the formula has no plain-words restatement. Fix: add a sentence that the model describes the run (`ready` is true) and that the run has no alternatives.

The docstring now lists PlainInsertStepCases among the fixtures and says "SchemaScriptReplays emits scripts of the same statements" and that pinned SQLite gives the same rows and refusals. But the new literal inserts, including the duplicate `(1,'a'), (1,'b')` batch, are not replayed against SQLite, so the docstring claims SQLite agreement for statements that only the model checks. Fix: say that the literal-insert cases are checked against the model only, or add those statements to SchemaScriptReplays with their expected rows and errors.
